meta.title: Hartwell & Okafor | Family law, wills and probate in Islington
meta.description: A small Islington law practice for divorce, children arrangements, wills, lasting powers of attorney and probate. Fixed fees where we can. Free 20 minute first call.

rationale: Clients arrive worried and unsure about cost, so the page is calm, serif-led and plain: warm paper background, deep green accent, no decoration. Services are written as prose because each one needs explaining, the process is a question and answer conversation to remove fear of the unknown, and every section points to the free first call.

props.headline: Clear legal help for the difficult moments in family life.
props.sub: We are a small Islington practice. We explain things in plain English, tell you the cost up front where we can, and start with a free 20 minute call.

photo.subject: The front of the Islington office or a calm meeting room with a table, two chairs and daylight from a window, no people posed for the camera

props.label: What we do
props.title: Three areas, done carefully
props.intro: We keep our work focused so that every client gets someone who does this every day.

items.name: Family law
items.description: Divorce, separation and arrangements for children. We help you understand your options, agree what we can without a fight, and speak up for you in court when it cannot be avoided.

items.name: Wills and lasting powers of attorney
items.description: A will makes sure your wishes are followed. A lasting power of attorney lets someone you trust make decisions for you if you cannot. We write both in plain language and walk you through each step.

items.name: Probate
items.description: When someone has died, there is a lot to do at a time when you least want to do it. We deal with the paperwork and the authorities and keep you informed throughout.

props.label: About cost
props.title: You should know what it costs before you decide

items.detail: For work with a clear shape we agree one price in advance. Where it cannot be fixed, we explain why and how we charge.
Tell us what is happening. We will say what we think you need, and whether we are the right people to help.
If a word needs a lawyer to explain it, we explain it.

props.label: How it works
props.title: What working with us is like

pairs.ask: I have never spoken to a solicitor. Where do I start?
pairs.answer: With a free 20 minute call. You tell us the situation, we listen, and we say what the next sensible step is. There is nothing to prepare.
We tell you before any work begins. Where we can, we quote a fixed fee, so there is no meter running in the background.

pairs.ask: Who will actually deal with my matter?
pairs.answer: One of our two partners, Clare Hartwell or Tunde Okafor, supported by our paralegal. You know who you are talking to.

pairs.ask: What if I am not sure I want to go ahead?
pairs.answer: Then you have lost nothing. The first call is free and comes with no obligation.

props.label: Who we are
props.title: A small practice, on purpose
paragraphs: Hartwell & Okafor is run by two partners, Clare Hartwell and Tunde Okafor, with a paralegal who helps keep every matter moving. We are based in Islington.

Most people come to us at a hard moment: a marriage ending, a parent who has died, a worry about the future. We know that cost is often part of the worry, which is why we offer fixed fees where we can and a free first call.
Staying small means you speak to the people who know your file, and we have the time to explain things properly.
props.pullQuote: You speak to the people who know your file.

props.line: Not sure where to begin? Start with a free 20 minute call.

items.q: Is the first call really free?
items.a: Yes. The first call lasts 20 minutes and costs nothing.

items.q: Do you always charge a fixed fee?
items.a: Where we can, yes. Some matters, such as a dispute that may end up in court, are harder to price in advance. We will tell you which kind yours is.

items.q: Can you help with both a divorce and arrangements for the children?
items.a: Yes. Family law is one of our main areas and covers divorce, separation and arrangements for children.

items.q: What is a lasting power of attorney?
items.a: It is a legal document that lets someone you trust make decisions for you if you are unable to. We can talk through the options on your first call.

items.q: Can you help after someone has died?
items.a: Yes. Probate is one of our areas of work, and we can explain what needs doing and in what order.
